headline: Board recommends $126,030,888 school budget for 2026-27, with a conditional music teacher amendment
summary: Staff presented budget changes, mainly to add special education staff for 2026-27. The board recommended the budget by a nine to nothing vote. It also approved an amendment to fund a music teacher at CMS from superintendent contingency, but only if the superintendent finds CMS students get fewer music lessons than students at other elementary schools.
decisions: Approved an amendment to fund a music teacher at CMS from superintendent contingency, only if the superintendent finds CMS students get fewer music lessons than at other elementary schools.
Recommended approval of the 2026-27 school budget totaling $126,030,888, by a nine to nothing vote.
discussion: Special education staffing: Staff presented added positions, including 14 educational assistants, a 1.0 charter and private school special educator, and a 0.2 occupational therapist increase, covered by moving money from other lines. Members asked what would happen for the rest of the year, and staff said reductions may be needed to meet IEP obligations.

Music lessons at CMS: Discussion noted that CMS lessons are now spaced further apart after position cuts. Views differed on whether other elementary schools see the same effect, since enrollment differs by school.
Local tax rate: Staff said the local rate would fall about 25% under the proposed budget, but the Department of Revenue must finalize the figures.
Beaver Meadow mold: Staff said a $100,000 increase to facility contingency responds to mold growth at Beaver Meadow, caused by settings that were not reset after summer weather changes.

decision_evidence.quote: I move that we reduce the superintendent contingency to replace the point 17 music teacher at CMS only if, after investigation, the superintendent finds that students at CMS are getting fewer music lessons than students at other elementary schools. that the sections are significantly larger. ... Motion passes.

I move that the board recommend approval of the 2026-2027 fiscal year budget with all funds totaling $126,030,888 with a general fund budget of $117,252,369, raising the amounts in local education taxes of $80,651,000. ... Motion passes, nine to nothing.
